requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement contains two distinct functional actions ('add System-B' and 'allow System-C to subscribe') without a quality or constraint criterion. Per Pohl §25.2, this concern-mixing issue requires decomposition into two separate functional requirements.

source_fragments: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems
structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A must add System-B to its downstream systems registry.
structuring_notes: Decomposed first functional action: 'add System-B to downstream systems'.

source_fragments: allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow
structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A must allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.
structuring_notes: Decomposed second functional action: 'allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow'.
